title: Baked squash, corn and goat's cheese

source.title: Jane Baxter's baked squash, corn and goat's cheese recipe

ingredients.name: Coriander
ingredients.amount: a handful, plus 1 tbsp for the dressing

instructions: Heat the oven to 190C/170C fan/gas 5. Peel and deseed the squash, cut into 1 to 2cm chunks, toss with 1 tbsp oil and seasoning on a tray and roast for about 30 minutes, until browning and just cooked.
Meanwhile, boil the corn for about 10 minutes, drain, refresh, and cut the kernels from the cobs.
Toss the roast squash with 2 finely chopped garlic cloves, the finely chopped red chillies and the corn. Move to an ovenproof serving dish and return to the oven for 5 minutes.

For the dressing, dry-fry the pumpkin seeds over a medium heat for 5 minutes, until toasted and popping. When cool, blend with the crushed garlic, tomatoes, lettuce, 1 tbsp coriander, green chillies, 2 tbsp oil and seasoning, adding a little water to a pouring consistency.
Fold the crumbled goat's cheese into the squash and return to the oven for about 10 minutes, until hot.
Squeeze over the lime, drizzle with the dressing, season and scatter with coriander. Serve with warm tortillas.
